top_signals.title: Top Rubis Shareholder Says Stock Offer Too Generous for Partners
top_signals.summary: The largest shareholder in Rubis SCA said the company’s proposal to grant 12.7 million new shares to its general partners was “too generous” and he would probably vote against the plan if it isn’t changed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
